# The goal of this script is to create kendall plots of δ15NSP vs δ18O in order to visualize reduction lines created from N2O reduction data. The final plot includes all endmember boxes and mixing lines, our in vitro reduction line, and the in vivo reduction line (median of previously published data)

- The *in vitro* isotopic data was measured for N~2~O reduction to N~2~ by purified *Pseudomonas stutzeri* (aka *Stutzerimonas stutzeri*) nitrous oxide reductase (N2OR) in the current study.
- The *in vivo* isotopic data was previously published by Yu, L., et al., 2020 (see reference below) and includes the following:
  - Endmember values for boxes
  - Slope of the *in vivo* reduction line (median)

## Reference

All data plotted for in vivo reduction lines and endmember values are from:
Yu L, Harris E, Lewicka-Szczebak D, et al. What can we learn from N2O isotope data? – Analytics, processes and modelling. Rapid Commun Mass Spectrom. 2020; 34:e8858. https://doi.org/10.1002/rcm.8858

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

#Load packages
```{r load_packages}
library(ggplot2)
library(here) #Used to create file paths relative to top-level directory.

```

#Input data
```{r input_data}
# ----------------------------
# 1) In vitro data (δ-space points)
# ----------------------------
df <- data.frame(
  d18O = c(39.6, 39.9, 43.4, 47.0, 48.9, 52.1, 56.2, 58.6, 61.9, 66.2, 68.2, 39.6, 39.5, 43.9, 47.3, 51.3, 54.0, 59.4, 63.3, 66.5, 39.3, 43.4, 46.4, 48.2, 51.4, 54.3, 58.3, 59.5, 64.6, 66.1),
  SP   = c(-0.8, -0.7, 2.1, 2.8, 5.5, 7.6, 10.2, 11.5, 14.0, 16.7, 18.2, -0.7, -1.1, 1.5, 3.9, 6.3, 8.8, 12.2, 14.0, 17.4, -1.2, 1, 3.3, 5.4, 6.2, 8.7, 10.6, 12.8, 15.3, 17.5)
)
```

#Make boxes
```{r make_boxes}
# ----------------------------
# 2) BOXES (δ-space ranges from Yu)
# ----------------------------
bacterial_box <- data.frame(
  xmin = 16.7, xmax = 23.3,   # δ18O range - range for soil incubations
  ymin = -7.5, ymax = 3.7    # SP range
)

fungal_box <- data.frame(
  xmin = 42.0, xmax = 55.1,    # δ18O range after normalization to soil water d18O
  ymin = 27.2, ymax = 39.9    # SP range
)

nitrifier_box <- data.frame(  #nitrifier-denitrification
  xmin = 12.4, xmax = 19.4,   # δ18O range
  ymin = -13.6, ymax = 1.9    # SP range
)

nitrification_box <- data.frame(
  xmin = 20.5, xmax = 26.5,   # δ18O range
  ymin = 32.0, ymax = 38.7    # SP range
)
```

#Define midpoints for each box
```{r box_midpoints}
#Bacterial denitrification (bD)
d18O0_bD <- 19.0        #median for soil incubation studies
SP0_bD <- -1.9          #median (and mean) for pure culture studies

#Nitrification (Ni)
d18O0_Ni <- 23.5         #atmospheric O2
SP0_Ni <- 34.6          #median

#Fungal denitrification (fD)
d18O0_fD <- 46.9       #median (pure culture studies, normalized to soil water d18O)
SP0_fD <- 33.6         #median (pure culture studies)

```


#Define reduction lines
```{r reduction_lines}
# ----------------------------
# 3) REDUCTION LINES (use ε values to get slope)
#    slope = εSP / ε18O
# ----------------------------

# --- Yu reduction ε values (use median values) ---
eps18O_yu <- -15.9      # median for controlled soil incubations
epsSP_yu  <- -6.0       # median for controlled soil incubations
slope_yu <- 0.36        # median value for εSP/ε18O in Yu, et al., 2020.

# choose a starting point for Yu reduction line in δ-space:
# (often you pick an initial/source point; you can use box center or your minimum-reduction sample)
# Use the initial delta values for our experiment
d18O0_yu <- 39.5        # (starting δ18O)
SP0_yu   <- -1.2         # (starting SP)
int_yu   <- SP0_yu - slope_yu * d18O0_yu

# --- Your reduction ε values (in vitro ε) ---
eps18O_you <- -13.5     # in vitro study
epsSP_you  <- -9.5      # in vitro study
slope_you  <- epsSP_you / eps18O_you

# choose your starting point in δ-space:
# Use initial d18O and SP values for our experiment (the average of the initial deltas from all 6 replicates, see Table 2 in MS)
d18O0_you <- 39.5       # in vitro study
SP0_you   <- -1.2        # in vitro study
int_you   <- SP0_you - slope_you * d18O0_you


# 4) DEFINE WHERE LINES END
# (extend to right side of your data)
# ----------------------------
x_end <- max(df$d18O) + 0
x_end_yu <- max(df$d18O) + 7.33
x_end_you <- max(df$d18O) + 4.33 #calculated d18O value at the end of rxn (f = 0)
y_end_yu  <- SP0_yu + slope_yu  * (x_end_yu - d18O0_yu)
y_end_you <- SP0_you + slope_you * (x_end_you - d18O0_you)
```

#Figure 4: Plot bD, fD, NI, and nD and mixing lines
```{r boxplot_mix}
# ----- Kendall plot with bD, fD, NI, and nD
p_kendallplot_mix <- ggplot() +
  
  # bacterial box
  geom_rect(data = bacterial_box,
            aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax),
            fill = "lightskyblue", alpha = 0.2) +
  
  # fungal box
  geom_rect(data = fungal_box,
            aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax),
            fill = "seagreen3", alpha = 0.2) +
  
  #nitrifier box (nitrifier-denitrification)
  geom_rect(data = nitrifier_box,
            aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax),
            fill = "salmon", alpha = 0.2) +
  
  # nitrification box
  geom_rect(data = nitrification_box,
            aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax),
            fill = "darkorchid4", alpha = 0.2) +
  
  geom_text(data = bacterial_box,
            aes(x = xmin, y = ymax, label = "bD"),
            hjust = 0, vjust = 1, nudge_x = 0.2, nudge_y = -8,
            size = 6, fontface = "bold") +
  
  geom_text(data = fungal_box,
            aes(x = xmin, y = ymax, label = "fD"),
            hjust = 0, vjust = 1, nudge_x = 0.2, nudge_y = -0.5,
            size = 6, fontface = "bold") +
  
  geom_text(data = nitrifier_box,
            aes(x = xmin, y = ymax, label = "nD"),
            hjust = 0, vjust = 1, nudge_x = 0.2, nudge_y = -12,
            size = 6, fontface = "bold") +
  
  geom_text(data = nitrification_box,
            aes(x = xmin, y = ymax, label = "Ni"),
            hjust = 0, vjust = 1, nudge_x = 0.2, nudge_y = -0.5,
            size = 6, fontface = "bold") +
  
  # your points
  geom_point(data = df, aes(x = d18O, y = SP,
                            color = "Data"), size = 3) +
  
  # Yu reduction line (segmented)
  geom_segment(
    aes(x = d18O0_yu, y = SP0_yu,
        xend = x_end_yu, yend = y_end_yu,
        color = "Yu et al."), linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1.2
  ) +
  
  # Your reduction line (segmented)
  geom_segment(
    aes(x = d18O0_you, y = SP0_you,
        xend = x_end_you, yend = y_end_you,
        color = "Purified N2OR reduction line"), linewidth = 1.2
  ) +
  
  #Ni-bD mixing line
  geom_segment(
    aes(x = d18O0_bD, y = SP0_bD,
        xend = d18O0_Ni, yend = SP0_Ni,
        color = "Mixing line"), linewidth = 1.2
  )+
  
  #fD-bD mixing line
  geom_segment(
    aes(x = d18O0_bD, y = SP0_bD,
        xend = d18O0_fD, yend = SP0_fD,
        color = "Mixing line"), linewidth = 1.2
  )+
  
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Yu et al." = "black",
      "Purified N2OR reduction line" = "red",
      "Data" = "darkblue",
      "Mixing line" = "gray"
    ),
    
    breaks = c(
       "Data", "Purified N2OR reduction line", "Yu et al.", "Mixing line"
    ),
    
    labels = c(
      expression("Purified "*N[2]*"OR "*(delta^15*N^SP)/(delta^18*O)),
      expression("Purified "*N[2]*"OR "*(epsilon^15*N^SP)/(epsilon^18*O)),
      expression(italic("In vivo") ~ (epsilon^15*N^SP)/(epsilon^18*O)),
      expression("Mixing line")
    )
  ) +
  
  labs(
    # title = expression("N"[2]*"O Dual Isotope Plot"),
    #subtitle = "Mixing lines start at bacterial box center (reduction origin)",
    x = expression(bold(delta^18*O ~ "(‰)")),
    y = expression(bold(delta^15*N^SP ~ "(‰)")),
    color = expression(N[2]*"OR Reduction Lines")
  ) +
  theme_classic () +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_text(size =18, face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 16),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 18),
    legend.text = element_text(size =16),
    panel.border = element_rect( color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth =1),
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
  )

print(p_kendallplot_mix) 
ggsave (
  filename = here("graphs/boxplot/Boxplot_SP_O_mix.tiff"),
  plot =p_kendallplot_mix,
  width = 8, height = 5, units = "in",
  dpi = 600, compression = "lzw")
```
